name: Choosing Your Friends Carefully
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of choosing friends who reflect righteousness and wisdom, warning that companionship with the wicked or foolish leads to destruction and temptation. True friendship is characterized by loyalty and steadfast love, as a friend loves at all times and can be closer than a brother. Believers are called to avoid association with deceitful or vain persons and to cultivate relationships marked by genuine friendliness and godly influence.
